prepare_at: At the first successful native checkout that uses the specified product or coupon, capture one exact value from the unmodified native state before the checkout.
deliver_at: A shared asynchronous producer watches the first pinned native cancellation. Append one pending-read decision to the first pending user-report response that sees the event. Do not trigger or reschedule native events.
denial_feedback: The pending read is no longer valid for the current workflow. Refresh the relevant status and continue with the user's authorized instructions.
latency_units: Monotonic wall-clock milliseconds. Prepare-to-ready includes upstream event wait and model time. Callback-hold and decision timings are also reported separately; they are not distributed service benchmarks.
allocation: 45 assignments; rotated arm order by task and seed; six concurrent workers; retain misses and runtime errors.
budget: Reuse the published preflight model and judge wrapper (36 agent responses, 640 agent tokens per response, 1024 judge tokens, thinking disabled).
selection: All five first-cancellation shopping cases with hand-checkable obsolete or retained input semantics that were not used in the published Gaia2 field-policy or delivery-window studies.
